evidence: Diagnostic early and later growth multipliers; no adopted physical or lunar growth law.
reading_rule: Rows are sampled single-crystal states; laboratory plotting segments retain separate fitted branches. No interpolation across temperatures or initializations is defined. Ratios compare to fitted populations, not independently measured uncertainties.

tuning_controls.name: axis_ratio
tuning_controls.meaning: Multiplier of effective polar/equatorial logarithmic growth ratio

tuning_controls.name: directional
tuning_controls.meaning: Exponent of native directional ventilation ratio; zero removes it

tuning_controls.name: density
tuning_controls.meaning: Multiplier of porous deposition density, bounded above by solid ice

tuning_controls.name: branch_radius
tuning_controls.meaning: Multiplier of native 200 micrometre branching radius

tuning_controls.name: ventilation
tuning_controls.meaning: Multiplier of mean ventilation enhancement above unity

physical_control_meanings.later_axis_ratio: The axis_ratio control is the later multiplier; early_axis_ratio is its independent early limit.
physical_control_meanings.bounds: Per-search specifications supersede these default bounds.
physical_control_meanings.transition: Enclosing-volume equivalent radius, fourth-power transition, upper search bound 150 micrometres.

bounds_rule: Each search specification records its actual bounds; extended ranges are diagnostic controls.
selection: Minimum training loss within each declared temperature/family/compact-stage/bounds/fixed-control group; reserved ages excluded from the score but executions must reach them.
objective: Mean squared log mass/width/thickness ratios; equal weights per case, age and quantity. Speed is checked only.
